issue.title: [devin-remediate] parseCookie mishandles compact cookies and values containing equals signs
issue.body:
## Problem
`parseCookie` currently splits on `; ` and then splits every `=`, so compact cookies like `a=1;b=2` and values like `token=a=b=c` are mishandled.

## Target
`superset-frontend/src/utils/parseCookie.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Split cookie pairs on semicolons with optional surrounding whitespace.
- Split each pair only on the first equals sign.
- Preserve values that contain equals signs.
- Keep empty cookie input returning `{}`.

## Suggested test command
`cd superset-frontend && yarn test src/utils/parseCookie.test.ts`

Please open a PR against this fork.
